base: Value of personal property administered (at time of disbursement or distribution) plus proceeds of real property sold under order of the probate court (RSMo § 473.153(1)).

schedules.text: 5% of the first $5,000; 4% of the next $20,000; 3% of the next $75,000; 2.75% of the next $300,000; 2.5% of the next $600,000; 2% of all over $1,000,000 (RSMo § 473.153(1)). This is a minimum: the court allows more where reasonable.
schedules.capNote: Minimum, not maximum. Two or more personal representatives: aggregate reasonable compensation not exceeding twice the schedule or 5%, whichever is less (§ 473.153(2)).

schedules.text: Attorneys receive as minimum compensation sums equal to the percentages of the § 473.153(1) schedule (RSMo § 473.153(3)).
